title: RelationshipExtraction
description: Call 2 of the native engine: facts between entities already extracted in call 1. Subject/object must be names from the provided entity list; predicates are ontology relationship types. Each predicate has a declared direction (schemas/ontology.yaml, ADR-0015); a reversed subject/object pair is flipped back or rejected on write.

subject.description: The thing the fact is about, taken verbatim from the entity list. Direction matters and is checked: write 'JobLab HAS_OWNER Mohammad', never 'Mohammad HAS_OWNER JobLab'.

object.description: The value of the fact. An entity name from the list, or - for HAS_STATUS and HAS_STAGE - a short literal value such as 'active' or 'bronze'.
